authors: Adamo Marianna; Pagnesi Matteo; Mebazaa Alexandre et al.
intervention_details: Rapid up-titration of guideline-recommended medical therapy (GRMT) - high intensity care (HIC) strategy with NT-proBNP monitoring (STRONG-HF)

title: Transitional Care Interventions to Prevent Readmissions for Persons With Heart Failure
authors: Cynthia Feltner; Christine D. Jones; Crystal W. Cené et al.
intervention_details: Transitional care interventions for HF (comprehensive AHRQ-funded review)

title: A Randomized Trial of Home Telemonitoring in a Typical Elderly Heart Failure Population in North West London: Results of the Home-HF Study
authors: Owais Dar; Jillian Riley; Callum Chapman et al.
intervention_details: Home telemonitoring for typical elderly HF population in North West London (Home-HF study)
secondary_outcomes: clinic visits; emergency room visits; costs
author_conclusions: Home telemonitoring achieved similar mortality outcomes to usual specialist care while reducing clinic and emergency visits.

title: Post-discharge Follow-up Characteristics Associated With 30-Day Readmission After Heart Failure Hospitalization
authors: Keane K. Lee; Jingrong Yang; Adrian F. Hernandez et al.
intervention_details: Post-discharge follow-up with cardiology or general medicine provider within 7 days of HF hospitalization
comparison_details: No follow-up or follow-up after 7 days
author_conclusions: Seeing a physician soon after discharge was linked to a lower 30-day readmission risk.

title: Remote Monitoring of Patients With Heart Failure: An Overview of Systematic Reviews
authors: Nazli Bashi; Mohan Karunanithi; Farhad Fatehi et al.
intervention_details: Remote monitoring for HF including telemonitoring, home telehealth, mobile phone monitoring, and videoconferencing
author_conclusions: Evidence was most supportive of established remote-monitoring programs, with newer digital approaches still requiring study.
